# 1 Enoch Chapter 46 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Parables (Similitudes)

---

**46:1** And there I saw One who had a Head of Days, and His head was white like wool. And with Him was another being whose face had the appearance of a man, and his countenance was full of grace, like one of the holy angels.

**46:2** And I asked the angel who accompanied me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Man — who he was, where he came from, and why he went with the Head of Days.

**46:3** And he answered me and said: 'This is the Son of Man who possesses righteousness, with whom righteousness dwells, and who reveals all the treasures of that which is hidden — because the Lord of Spirits has chosen him, and his portion surpasses all before the Lord of Spirits in uprightness forever.

**46:4** And this Son of Man whom you have seen shall unseat the kings and the mighty from their thrones, and loosen the grip of the powerful, and break the teeth of sinners.

**46:5** He shall depose the kings from their thrones and kingdoms, because they do not exalt and praise Him, nor humbly acknowledge the One from whom their kingdom was bestowed upon them.

**46:6** He shall bring down the faces of the powerful and fill them with shame. Darkness shall be their dwelling, and worms shall be their bed, and they shall have no hope of rising from their resting place — because they do not extol the name of the Lord of Spirits.

**46:7** These are the ones who judge the stars of heaven, who raise their hands against the Most High, who tread upon the earth and dwell on it. All their deeds display unrighteousness; their power rests on their wealth, and their faith is in the gods they have made with their hands. They deny the name of the Lord of Spirits.

**46:8** They shall be driven from the houses of His congregation and of the faithful who depend on the name of the Lord of Spirits.


---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering adjudicated from EMET (literal), LOGOS (formal), and PNEUMA (dynamic). Where the three converge, the shared rendering is adopted. Where they diverge, SOPHIA selects the rendering that best preserves accuracy while remaining accessible, with divergences logged in the disagreement file.*
